messages.subject: Session time for  download
parts:
Hi,

In my shiny app (http://comet.epigen.kcl.ac.uk:3838/comet/), I create first a png image and after that, I ask if they want to download the file.
The format of file could be png, pdf, eps format.

My problem is that the creation of plot takes a little time and if I ask to produce the pdf file, I have an error message because the connection is stopped.

I tried to increase the session time in the configuration file, but I have error message to run my app

app_init_timeout 3600;
app_idle_timeout 3600;

Do you have idea to create pdf or eps  file ?
Do you have idea to extend the session time  to create a file with downloadbutton?




This is my function

output$downloadPlot <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste(input$plotfilename, input$imageformat, sep='.') },
    content = function(filename) {
      if(input$imageformat == "pdf"){
        pdf(encoding = "ISOLatin1.enc",
            file = filenameImage,
            onefile=FALSE,
            width=as.numeric(input$imagesize),
            height=as.numeric(input$imagesize),
            paper="special")
      }
      if(input$imageformat == "eps"){
        postscript(encoding = "ISOLatin1.enc",
                   file = filenameImage,
                   horizontal=FALSE,
                   onefile=FALSE,
                   width=as.numeric(input$imagesize),
                   height=as.numeric(input$imagesize),
                   paper="special",
                   pagecentre=TRUE,
                   fonts=c("sans"))
      }
      if(input$imageformat == "png"){
        png(file = filenameImage,
            width=as.numeric(input$imagesize),
            height=as.numeric(input$imagesize),
            fonts=c("sans"))
      }
      #lena = readImage(filenameImage)
      #display(lena)
      cometplotPrint()
      dev.off()
    }
  )

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Session time for download
parts:
Shoot. I think you're hitting a hard-coded timeout in Shiny Server:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/blob/master/lib/main.js#L185

Is there any way that your code could be refactored using reactive expressions so that the results of the calculation can be shared between the in-app plot and the file download? You can't do actual plotting commands in the reactive expression, but is a big part of the time in cometplotPrint just calculations that need to happen before you actually start plotting?

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Session time for  download
parts: Scott: an easy workaround would be to have two buttons, one for "generate the data" and one for "download the data".  Have the "download" button disabled to begin with, when you click on "generate" it'll do all the computation, when it's done it'll enable the "download" button, and clicking on "download" will simply serve the file that was already created before
